memory_update.text: LW is the cleanest US-listed direct frozen potato/French fry processor exposure; use as reference anchor, not necessarily as the only alpha candidate.
JBTM is a promising underfollowed second-order candidate because potato/fry processing equipment and automation may be misclassified inside diversified food-processing machinery.

Cold-chain infrastructure appears to be a credible adjacent chokepoint for frozen fries because processor filings cite warehousing/distribution disruption risk and cold-storage REITs serve frozen-food producers and distributors.
Need primary evidence tying COLD or LINE directly to frozen potato processors, QSR distributors, or major restaurant systems before upgrading from hypothesis to inference/fact.

node: Frozen potato products and French fry supply
summary: Expanded the frozen potato/French fry node into a compact US-listed universe. The direct public processor exposure is narrow: Lamb Weston is the obvious pure-play reference name, while most other scaled fry processors such as McCain, Simplot and Cavendish are private or not clean US-listed equities. The underfollowed lane therefore shifts one step away from the processor into potato/fry processing equipment and frozen-food cold-chain infrastructure, where public companies may benefit from QSR dependence on consistent, high-volume frozen fry supply but require customer-specific verification.
